product_overview: Aurora Care is a web-based healthcare support platform that helps users connect with doctors and caretakers, book consultation or care services, and receive ML-assisted skin-care guidance. It also includes separate admin capabilities for managing service providers.
core_goals: Find and view available doctors, caretakers, and therapists
Book an available provider and time slot for a care or consultation service
Complete payment for applicable bookings and receive confirmation
Upload a skin image to receive informational analysis and guidance
Log in to access profile details and manage account access
Use the admin portal to add or remove service providers

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Users can log in to access protected account areas and view their stored profile information.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email and password -> Submit the login form -> See the dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit the login form -> See validation feedback
Log in successfully -> Open profile information -> View stored user details

features.name: Browse Providers
features.description: Users can explore available doctors and caretakers/therapists and review provider information before booking.
user_flows: Navigate to /doctors -> Review the list of available doctors -> Open a doctor’s details -> View specialization, availability, and booking information
Navigate to /caretakers -> Review the list of available caretakers and therapists -> Open a provider’s details -> View role, availability, and service information

features.name: Skin Check
features.description: Authenticated users can upload a skin image for ML-assisted analysis and view informational results with guidance when professional care may be needed.
user_flows: Navigate to /skin-check -> Upload a supported skin image -> Start the analysis -> View the classification result and guidance
Navigate to /skin-check -> Upload an unsupported file type -> Start the analysis -> See input validation feedback
Navigate to /skin-check -> Upload a skin image -> Start the analysis -> View results that recommend consulting a doctor for serious or uncertain cases

features.name: Admin Provider Management
features.description: Administrators can use the separate admin portal to manage doctors, caretakers, nurses, and therapists in the provider list.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/login -> Enter admin credentials -> Submit the admin login form -> See the admin dashboard
Navigate to /admin/login -> Enter invalid admin credentials -> Submit the admin login form -> See validation feedback
Log in to the admin dashboard -> Add a new service provider with name, role, specialization, phone number, and availability -> See the provider appear in the managed list
Log in to the admin dashboard -> Remove an existing service provider -> See the provider removed from the available list
